sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
"Hmm? What am I doing out here?
Making sweet rice cakes, of course!
You've never heard of it? Really?! Then you need to try some!
It's a traditional treat from the South that's eaten every Harvest Festival! They're called "bunnytails" because they look just like one!
It's soft, and chewy, and fluffy...and really sweet!"
— QiuTong in Moonlight Harvest

QiuTong is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. She is a celestial being that descends into Aimyhr every year during Autumn, disguised as a young girl.

sections.title: Debut Appearance
sections.content: As an NPC character, QiuTong first appears in the Festive Event, Moonlight Harvest.

sections.title: As a unit
sections.content: See Autumn Child QiuTong and Lunar Maiden QiuTong
